title: Ape Academy 2
platDesc: Unlock all trophies in Ape Academy 2.

trophies.name: Beginner Card Player
trophies.desc: Defeat the boss on Traffic Safety Island.

trophies.name: Novice Card Player
trophies.desc: Defeat the boss at Sumo Paradise.

trophies.name: Average Card Player
trophies.desc: Defeat the boss on Pop Queen Island.

trophies.name: Card Shark
trophies.desc: Defeat the boss at White Monkey Preserve.

trophies.name: Professional Card Player
trophies.desc: Defeat the boss at Red Hot Macho Resort.

trophies.name: Specter Decked Out
trophies.desc: Defeat Specter on Spaceship Island.

trophies.name: Ambushed!
trophies.desc: Win against Yellow Pipotron.

trophies.name: Don't the Pipotron Ever Learn?
trophies.desc: Win against Blue Pipotron.

trophies.name: The Monkey Business Ends Here
trophies.desc: Win against Red Pipotron.

trophies.name: Uncommon Strength
trophies.desc: Play a card requiring 9 or 10 bananas in a card battle.

trophies.name: Rare Power
trophies.desc: Play a card requiring 11 or 12 bananas in a card battle.

trophies.name: Give 'Em the 1, 2 Punch
trophies.desc: Execute a Combo in a card battle.

trophies.name: Unlucky Draw
trophies.desc: Cause a Redraw in a card battle.

trophies.name: Monkey Defender
trophies.desc: Successfully defend against a penalty.

trophies.name: Monkey Original
trophies.desc: Play against a classic monkey in a card battle.

trophies.name: Monkey Fencer
trophies.desc: Play 50 minigames in One player Card Battle.

trophies.name: Academy Champ
trophies.desc: Win 50 card battles.

trophies.name: Shop and Go Seek
trophies.desc: Discover a hidden shop.

trophies.name: Collector of Cardboard
trophies.desc: Obtain 20% of the cards.

trophies.name: Leisurely Reading
trophies.desc: View the Monkey Album on the Main Menu.

trophies.name: It Goes into Letters?!
trophies.desc: Get promoted to a letter rank.

trophies.name: A is for Ape
trophies.desc: Get promoted to Rank A.

trophies.name: On Demand Play
trophies.desc: Play a minigame through the Monkey Album.

trophies.name: Monkey Savings
trophies.desc: Hold 10 bananas during a card battle.

trophies.name: Going Bananas
trophies.desc: Hold 20 bananas during a card battle.

trophies.name: We Are Equals
trophies.desc: Challenge Specter with a Rank of B or higher.

trophies.name: I Need a Boost
trophies.desc: Buy a card pack in any shop.

trophies.name: Recycling
trophies.desc: Sell a card in any shop.
